title: The Role of Gatekeepers in Capital Markets

scopes.description: The frozen paper title is “The Role of Gatekeepers in Capital Markets,” while the sole supplied appendix is headed “Measuring Disclosure Using 8-K Filings.” If intended for this package, Appendix A documents an SEC 8-K/exhibit workflow for 2005–2016: classify items, match exhibits, remove images and unmatched exhibits, aggregate counts/word counts by firm-quarter, apply keyword searches, and screen firms using a Compustat CIK match. The appendix is substantive workflow documentation, but no executable program is supplied and its relationship to the frozen paper remains unresolved.

requirements.description: The documented workflow uses all available SEC EDGAR Form 8-K filings and attached exhibits from January 2005 through December 2016. The appendix specifies item/exhibit identification and matching, image removal, unmatched-exhibit treatment, word counting and keyword rules. No source files are included in this package.

routes.description: Official SEC EDGAR Company Filings Search and Archives provide historical Form 8-K filing-detail pages and linked primary/exhibit documents. Official records bracket the author period with 2005 and 2016 Form 8-K examples; the SEC states public EDGAR filing content is free to access and reuse. Acquisition of the complete target population and application of the appendix rules remain preparation work.
expected_fields: linked exhibit documents and exhibit labels

routes.description: common/README.md documents raw full filings under ${ACCTREPL_SEC_RAW} and parsed files under ${ACCTREPL_SEC_PARSED}. These are a local candidate for the required filing/exhibit text input; compatibility with the 2005–2016 8-K item, full-text, exhibit and matching contract has not been checked, and the directories were not scanned.

requirements.description: The appendix requires Compustat records joined by SEC CIK and screens for nonzero total assets and nonmissing net income. It does not identify annual versus quarterly frequency, the Compustat observation date/alignment rule, or exact table. Local metadata identifies candidate Compustat tables, but compatibility with the appendix input contract is unresolved.

routes.description: Local annual fundamentals table at ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/comp/d_na/funda.sas7bdat is readable and has cik, at and ni. This is a candidate only: the appendix does not state annual frequency or the data-date rule, and one-row readability does not establish the required period or match compatibility. COMP.FUNDQ is separately catalogued as quarterly and is not assumed equivalent.
routes.expected_period: Compustat observations for firms in the Q1 2005–Q4 2016 sample; exact frequency and observation-date alignment unspecified.

issues.description: The assigned inventory contains only an explanatory appendix PDF. It documents a manual/narrative processing workflow and measurement rules but supplies no executable program or complete author-prepared data file; there is no runnable entry point.

The PDF heading “Measuring Disclosure Using 8-K Filings” conflicts with the frozen package title “The Role of Gatekeepers in Capital Markets.” Confirm whether this appendix belongs to the assigned paper; do not assume it defines the complete frozen-paper workflow.

The Compustat screen is named, but annual/quarterly frequency, observation-date alignment and the exact table/field mapping are not specified. Local COMP.FUNDA and COMP.FUNDQ metadata are distinct candidate tables; their full period coverage and intended use are unverified.

evidence.description: The frozen package inventory contains one PDF appendix and no executable code or empirical data files.

review_notes: Appendix A is credited as substantive workflow documentation: its flowchart, matching rules, word-count rules and keyword strings are concrete, but they are not executable code.

The SEC public-route finding is an inference from official SEC access guidance and official filing-detail pages at 2005 and 2016. It establishes a public source route, not that a complete population has been acquired or that author cleaning has been reproduced.

Bounded one-row reads establish that catalogued SEC metadata and Compustat candidate tables are locally readable and expose relevant columns. They do not establish full-period coverage, exhibit text compatibility, or the intended Compustat frequency. COMP.FUNDA and COMP.FUNDQ are not treated as interchangeable.
No analysis-only scope is supported because this package supplies no executable analysis program or prepared analysis dataset.
